data.title: Rapamycin-induced inhibition of the 70-kilodalton S6 protein kinase
data.authors: Price DJ; Bierer BE et al.

evidence.label: Molecular — cells, biochemistry, structure
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

data.finding: Rapamycin induces dephosphorylation/inactivation of the 70 kDa S6 kinase, defining an early readout of TOR signalling.
data.abstract_excerpt: The immunosuppressant rapamycin inhibited proliferation of the H4IIEC hepatoma cell line. Rapamycin, but not its structural analog FK506, also inhibited the basal and insulin-stimulated activity of the p70 ribosomal protein S6 kinase. By contrast, insulin stimulation of the p85 Rsk S6 kinase and mitogen-activated protein (MAP) kinase activity were unaffected by drug.

extracted_findings.effect: Rapamycin (not FK506) inhibits basal and insulin-stimulated p70 S6 kinase activity
